title: Time bound for the polynomial length checker
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $e$, the corresponding length-checking machine computes, on every finite bit string $x$, the one-bit function that outputs $1$ exactly when $x$ decodes as a pair $(a,b)$ and $|b|\le C(|a|+1)^e$, and outputs $0$ otherwise. Its running time on inputs of length $n$ is bounded by $(C+5e+17)((n+1)^e+n+1)$.
